title: The work. The evidence. The whole story.

scenes.label: Parallel sessions
scenes.heading: Parallel work, in one view.
scenes.subtitle: Active project sessions with their claims and latest recorded activity.
scenes.takeaway: Inspect captured sessions and child agents. Missing capture stays visible.

scenes.label: Work & evidence
scenes.heading: Every task has a trail.
scenes.subtitle: Purpose, method, result and proof stay with the work.
scenes.takeaway: Open a completion to inspect what changed, who finished it and the linked proof.

scenes.label: Runs & logs
scenes.heading: See what is running.
scenes.subtitle: Profile stages connect recorded attempts to their logs.
scenes.takeaway: Follow live output or revisit a past attempt. Current acceptance is checked separately.

scenes.label: Live job monitor
scenes.heading: Follow jobs side by side.
scenes.subtitle: Profile-enabled log tiles follow each job as its stage changes.
scenes.takeaway: Focus a tile, pause following, or pin finished jobs to compare their output.

scenes.label: Log analysis
scenes.heading: Read the signal in the log.
scenes.subtitle: Flagged lines, filters and findings tied to exact quotes.
scenes.takeaway: Built-in log scanning; profiles can add agent reviews with confirmed or disputed findings.

scenes.label: Project wiki
scenes.heading: Keep the context of the work.
scenes.subtitle: Passive capture feeds a project-local wiki for your agents.
scenes.takeaway: Capture keeps the source. Raw notes do not become trusted lessons automatically.

scenes.label: Session analytics
scenes.heading: Look inside a working session.
scenes.subtitle: Usage, context growth, tools and the visible conversation.
scenes.takeaway: Trace measurements to source records. Missing usage or pricing stays unavailable.
